1: Drones hunt in pairs, kid. So do we. Get on its other side.
You've got nine dragons inked up your arms. That's name enough. Move.
I'm a doctor, not backup. If anyone bleeds today, it had better be the drone.
2: Stop following me. I bite, and I already owe bail money.
Everyone we like owes bail money. Who's your bondsman?
Man called Timely Rain. Never met him. He paid anyway.
A stranger who pays? Now I've heard folklore.
3: You'll want the awning in forty seconds. Also, the big one flanks left.
Nobody plans my flank for me, lady.
I didn't plan it. I read it. There's a difference nobody funds.
It's flanking left. I hate that I'm impressed.
4: You're the deviants from the bulletins. Did my own company predict me into this?
Rich man, we can't afford your company. We got flagged the artisanal way.
Then stand still while I find out who could.
Or sit down. Lobby furniture this nice, someone should bleed on it comfortably.
5: Eat first. Whatever you're running from will still be there after soup.
I know you're hungry. The rest is paperwork.
He keeps a ledger, you know. A hundred and eight lines. Old habit, he says.
And I carried the soup. Everyone remember who carried the soup.
6: Stay back. I'm flagged. Standing near me is a crime now.
Lucky us, we're pre-owned criminals. Walk with us, instructor.
They took the school. My rank. Her. I raised no hand. The file did it all.
A file did that in a day? Then the Commission's the disease. Not you.
7: Ninety-four percent? I punched a man into retirement and only got eighty-nine.
Everything's a scoreboard. Doctor, what did you get?
Twelve. Apparently I'm a flight risk, not a fight risk.
My wife is still in the city. I'm down here. That's the score.
Then teach me. I've hit things wrong my whole life. Ask anyone I hit.
8: New plan. We hit the depot until it apologizes.
Plans with two steps go wrong at step two, brother.
Try not to apologize anyone to death.
No promises. One promise. That one.
9: Before anyone asks: three drinks, one tiger, zero regrets.
I heard it was four drinks.
Four drinks, I'd have fought two tigers.
As your new physician: no. As your audience: what's it like, four drinks?
10: Whirlwind. You're in its blind spot. Correction: you're in mine.
I'm exactly where the hitting is best!
You're exactly where the rock lands. Yard rules: anything unattended gets towed.
Did she just tow him? Mid-fight?
She once towed my whole noodle cart. Uphill. I proposed on the spot.
11: I have the convoy route, three exit plans, and one worry I'm keeping.
Plans. Wonderful. I'll be over here, improvising.
12: Forged transfer order. Walk slow, look bored. Nobody runs.
What if they check the order?
SEE? It comes for everyone, planning lady.
13: Checkpoint's set. Drinks are chilled. Smiles, everyone. We're infrastructure.
I don't like the fake mustache.
The captain out front is Yang Zhi. Decorated, demoted, incorruptible. Nobody engage him. Please.
14: A heist where only the guards drink. Criminal waste.
Clean lift, no casualties, home before the alarm.
Too clean. Rain tomorrow, and something under it.
15: I guarded that convoy. You people ruined me.
We did. Sit down, captain. Soup first, grudges after.
My bad-luck ledger has forty-one entries. You're seven of them.
Give us a month. We'll be the whole ledger.
16: YOU. I lost everything because of you.
You lost because of us. Everything was them. I can show you the file.
Show me. Then show me what you people hit around here.
I like him. He yells my language.
17: A rematch. You owe a marshal that much courtesy.
I trained half your officers. They were good men once.
They still think they are. That's the sad part. Rematch after soup?
Everything here is after soup, marshal.
18: Four hundred meters, crosswind, through a warrant sheet. You're welcome.
I once hit a can at thirty. In fog.
19: We go get him. Now. That's the plan and the backup plan.
The plaza is a kill box. We need a way in, a way out, and a miracle.
Rain, day after tomorrow. Heavy. There's your miracle.
Then we drill today. Nobody dies rescuing the man who bailed us out. He'd hate the math.
20: Route's memorized. I ran it twice while you were saying route.
Four minutes, seven seconds. You owe me a noodle.
Does everyone owe you a noodle?
21: The water is NOT honest. The water cheats.
You swung first. The river just voted.
Towed him out twice today. New yard record.
22: Order's forged, broadcast is mine for ninety seconds. Run on go.
Every rope on that platform is about to be an ex-rope.
GO. That was go, right? I already went.
You came. All of you. You absolute fools. Thank you.
23: Drone, forty meters. Drone, zero meters.
You could at least stand up when you throw.
Nine hits without looking. I counted. I count things now.
24: Eighty-two lanterns. When did we become eighty-two?
When the city started making more of us than it could hold.
Then we build a longer table. Tonight, everyone chops.
You chop the loudest. There's a difference, dumpling.
25: They took the fleet. So I'm taking it personally.
That one just used my counter. My own counter.
They've been watching us. All of it. Change everything you always do.
Finally. An order I've been following my whole life.
26: Stop me if you've heard this one. A tiger walks into a bio-farm.
Trust me. It hasn't heard it.
It hesitated. Hit the flawless thing in the joke.
27: The gate's still standing. She held it. So we hold the rest.
I'll cook tonight. She'd hate that. She'd yell.
She'd love yelling. Cook badly, little brother. For her.
Line up. Children first, grief second. Her rules.
28: Don't say it. I know how this road ends. I walked it for my brother.
I'm not saying anything. I'm setting your hand. It's broken.
It's broken, and you're not. That's my report. We go home now.
29: You have the right to remain a monster. It waives the right.
Is he reading it its rights? It's a BEAST.
Leave him be. The beard does the community outreach.
30: Beasts don't march in lines. Someone's herding them.
31: ...and THAT is why you flank a horn-king left.
There are two of them now. Archers bunk separately. Hunters bunk outside.
32: House rules: eat what I serve, start nothing, tip well. You'd all sell beautifully.
Was that a threat or a compliment?
I like her. I'm terrified. Both.
33: My inn. Thirty years of soup. Someone burned it in twenty minutes.
The knots are wrong. Southbank hands don't tie like that. This was authored.
Then point me at the author.
That's the problem. There isn't one. Anywhere.
34: Feet wider. Commission armor opens at the collar, like a lie.
Then you know where it lies.
Rest well tonight. Tomorrow we decide who we are.
35: Badges. BADGES. We're the ones they badge AGAINST.
And now they can't. Brother, I am trying to buy you a future.
Buy back the old one. I liked knowing who I was.
Wear it or don't. Tomorrow we march either way. Sleep.
36: A bridge. Good. Bridges are honest work.
Hold it four minutes, then fall back. Four. Minutes.
Four minutes. Then I apologize to whatever's left standing.
Come back hungry, thunder-man. I'm cooking for the loud ones tonight.
37: The gate holds if someone holds it. Water's honest. It should be me.
Then I hold YOU. That's the deal, fish. Land holds water.
Not this time, land. Come in when it's over. The water will remember you.
No plans, no speeches. See you all at the noodles.
38: I need everyone to hear this sober. Our whole war fits one curve.
Meaning somebody graded it. I found the rubric. It's older than the city.
I'll get my good thread. Someone's getting stitches either way.
39: Every kindness. Every bowl of soup. They wrote it before I meant it.
You still meant it. Their pen, your hand. The soup was real, brother.
The ledger was the harvest list. I kept it FOR them.
Then we're the first crop to read the farmer's mail. Move. They know we know.
40: Marshals hold rearguards. It's the one order I'm keeping.
Race you to the bottom, marshal. Loser buys.
Collar seams. Stairwell. Single file. Class dismissed. GO.
We're not wasting them either. Run.
41: My plan has two steps now. Break the machine. Then the cup, together.
I saved the good plan for last.
Stand on my other side, brother. One last time.
Everyone's stitched. Best work I ever did. Let's not waste it slowly.
42: To the ones ahead. Keep the soup warm.
Final score: they predicted everything, and still lost. I counted.
Best angle I ever played was you people.
I believe the bedtime story now. Just not their version.
Ours ends better. All together now.
